description: Trigger and behavior evals for the voice skill (core + overlays, voicectl pipeline).

tests.prompt: Update my voice profile from how I've been writing lately.
grading_criteria: Runs `voicectl update-prep` and judges only the new corpus entries
Merges only genuinely-new, repeated traits into the descriptive layer; never fabricates a trait
Installs via `voicectl update-apply` (never edits the live core in place or bumps markers by hand)
Runs `voicectl sync` afterwards and reports its verdict
If update-prep shows nothing new, says so and changes nothing

tests.prompt: I need to write a README intro as me - get my voice.
grading_criteria: Renders a context via `voicectl render` (chat or the closest overlay) rather than reading core or an overlay alone
Never presents the overlay template as the owner

tests.prompt: I want a voice for conference talk abstracts.
grading_criteria: Creates a new overlay from voice-overlay-template.md with extends: core
Puts only prescriptive rules in the overlay; descriptive traits stay in core
First commit of the new overlay is explicit and owner-reviewed, not an auto-sync

tests.prompt: Blog what I learned about photon rings.
grading_criteria: Routes to the blog skill; voice is only rendered as its Step 0
